    # Connect vertical beams to horizontal beams at y=10.5m
    for (vertical_beam, x_center) in vertical_beams:
        # Connect to the horizontal beam at x_center, y=10.5
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(vertical_beam, horizontal_beams[0][0], anchor_point=(x_center, y_center), type='rigid')
    
    # Ensure horizontal beams are connected to each other (optional for continuity)
    for i in range(len(horizontal_beams) - 1):
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(horizontal_beams[i][0], horizontal_beams[i + 1][0], anchor_point=(horizontal_beams[i][1], y_center), type='rigid')
    
    return vertical_beams[0][0]  # Return any beam as the chassis reference
